senses.gloss: (b. h. עוֹלֵל Pol. to bring about) to go about,
(cmp. סוּר I ch.) to superintend, be busy.
units: Koh. R. to VI, 10 … מלך ומסרו לאריס לַעֲלוֹל בו a King that had a vineyard and gave it in charge of a tenant to attend to it (ed. Wil. לעֹמול).—Part. pass. עָלוּל; f. עֲלוּלָה; pl. עֲלוּלִים, עֲלוּלִין; עֲלוּלוֹת [brought about,] liable, likely (cmp. רָגִיל).
<cite ref="Niddah 7b:48">Nidd. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ לקבל טומאה</he> likely to catch uncleanness; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 2:11">Tosef. Makhsh. II, 11</cite>.

senses.gloss: (with ל־; cmp. סוּר I) to ascend, land, enter.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:5:1">Koh. R. to VI, 5</cite> <he>למה לא עָלַלְתָּה למדינה</he> why didst thou not visit the city?; <he>ואת שירדת ועָלַלְתָּ</he> and thou who didst go down (leave the ship) and visit; (Yalk. ib. 972 <cite ref="P00003"><he>עאל</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00845"><he>עלת</he></cite>, <he>עיילת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00241"><he>עוּל</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="P00816">next w.</cite>).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71a:4">Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>עוֹל תחתי לעוצר</he> go for me to the collector (settle with him).

senses.gloss: (b. h.), Nithpa. נִתְעַלֵּל [to busy one’s self,] to sport, abuse.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 58a:3">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 276:1">Yalk. Jer. 276</cite>; a. e.
